name: Upsell.com
summary: Shopify upsell app, formerly ReConvert: AI-driven cart, checkout and post-purchase upsell and cross-sell funnels, frequently-bought-together and product page recommendations, A/B testing and analytics with segmentation.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want one funnel covering product page, cart, post-purchase and thank-you offers with AI recommendations and A/B testing, and who sit under 500 orders a month, where the listing's Growth bands run from $9.99 to $39.99
skip_if: you are close to 2,000 orders a month, because the next rung is Scale at $299 a month and the vendor says it adds support rather than features, or you are not on Shopify Plus and were buying this for the checkout upsells, which stay closed to you
honest_knock: Growth is banded and cheap up to 500 orders, but the step after Growth is steep. The Shopify listing prints $9.99, $19.99 and $39.99 for the first three paid bands; the 1,000 and 2,000 bands are not in the served page. Past 2,000 orders a month, Scale costs $299 a month ($249 on annual) for a feature set the vendor says is identical on every plan; what it adds is priority chat, guided onboarding and earlier access to features. The pricing page also argues with itself twice: the Scale and Elite cards say billed monthly while the comparison table says annual only, and the annual toggle promises 25% off while the card prices work out at about 17%. Checkout upsells are still Shopify Plus only, so on a standard Shopify plan the checkout stage of the funnel stays shut.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Growth · per month for 51-100 monthly store orders or upsell revenue on the Shopify listing
pricing.notes: (prices re-verified 2026-11-09 on upsell.com/pricing in the Shopify view and on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/reconvert-upsell-cross-sell the same day; this replaces the $199 Scale and $499 Elite rungs we recorded on 19 September) Billed in USD. The vendor's comparison still says "Every feature is included on every plan. Tiers differ by order volume and support", so you are buying volume and support, not features. Free covers up to 50 monthly store orders or upsell revenue, whichever is higher. Growth is priced by volume band up to 2,000. The Shopify listing prints the first three paid bands: $9.99 a month for 51-100, $19.99 for 101-200 and $39.99 for 201-500. The 1,000 and 2,000 bands sit behind a slider on upsell.com whose amounts are not in the served page, so we do not state them. Scale is $299 a month billed monthly, or $249 a month on the annual toggle, up to 10,000. Elite is $899 a month, or $749 on annual, up to 20,000. Enterprise is quote-only above 20,000 and adds one invoice across multiple stores. The page labels the annual toggle "Save 25% with Annual", but $249 against $299 and $749 against $899 both work out at about 17% off (our arithmetic). The page still disagrees with itself on billing: the Scale and Elite cards say "Billed monthly" while the comparison table lists both as "Annual only" and only Growth as "Monthly or annual". Both the pricing page and the listing offer a 14-day free trial. Checkout upsells remain for Shopify Plus stores only.

schema_offer.description: Growth, per month for 51-100 monthly store orders or upsell revenue on the Shopify listing; $19.99 to 200 and $39.99 to 500; the Growth bands to 1,000 and 2,000 are not in the served page; Scale $299 to 10,000 ($249 a month on annual), Elite $899 to 20,000 ($749 on annual). Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-09.

compare_with.name: AfterSell
compare_with.why: Both cover the post-purchase and checkout upsell ground on Shopify. Upsell.com, formerly ReConvert, now lists its whole ladder on upsell.com/pricing, but only the first three Growth bands carry amounts in the served page ($9.99, $19.99 and $39.99, up to 500 orders, on the Shopify listing), and the step past 2,000 orders is to $299 a month. Compare the two on the order volume you expect in a year, not on today's.
